scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M layer-1 D8 Q4 gate/up persistent-expert diagnostic on gfx1151

design.geometry: one local128 workgroup per expert and 128 output columns
design.weight_reuse: stage all eight K32 decoded weight tiles for one K256 slab, then process every 32-row tile of the expert sequentially
design.accumulation: same split16 D8 packed dots and order as production; F32 partial output spilled between 12 K256 slabs

correctness.synthetic: BF16 byte-identical to production row-vector MMQ for counts 0/7/18/65 at K512 and dual N128
correctness.full_quality_gate_reason: actual-weight leaf performance rejected the premise

leaf.protocol: actual layer-1 weights and natural pp512 routing; pack-inclusive; two warmups; seven counter-rotated samples; burst=3
leaf.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py /home/lhl/models/gguf/laguna-s-2.1-Q4_K_M.gguf --repacked-cache /home/lhl/models/gguf/laguna-s-2.1-Q4_K_M.hipengine-repacked-v1 --routing-json /tmp/laguna-lap0-routing-8d26a9562.json --rows 512 --layer 1 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-rowvec,t16-persistent128x32-d8-f32 --warmups 2 --samples 7 --burst 3
leaf.qualification: candidate owns only experts above 32 rows; its measured time excludes the still-required production launch for smaller active experts

decision: Reject and remove. The large-expert persistent subset is already 16.14% slower than the complete production leaf before adding the required small-expert launch. K256 weight reuse cannot repay 42.5 KiB LDS residency plus 40 MiB of repeated F32 partial traffic.
